ValidationRule.description: If Credit Evaluation Result = Accept then Final DBR is a mandatory field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c), ISPICKVAL( cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c , "Accept"), ISBLANK( cc_Final_DBR__c ), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Type , "Convert Credit Card Nature Application"), AND(ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Final DBR Value
